items.title: File Widerspruch against the rejection
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Marktplatz am Bach 1, 22081 Hamburg erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post. Under § 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG a letter sent by simple post counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 19.11. + 4 days = Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to this deemed-delivery rule itself). Under § 31 Abs. 1 VwVfG / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of delivery (23.11.) is not counted; the one-month period (§ 31 Abs. 1 VwVfG / § 188 Abs. 2 BGB) runs from 24.11.2026 and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a normal working day in Hamburg (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday), so no further shift applies. Deadline: 23.12.2026.
